key_point: The Sims was born after its creator lost his home in a fire and had to rebuild his life
title: The Sims exists because its creator lost his home in a fire.
caption: The Sims exists because its creator lost his home in a fire. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #thesims #willwright #maxis

instagram.caption:
The Sims exists because its creator lost his home in a fire.

In 1991 the Oakland firestorm burned Will Wright's house down. He had to rebuild his life from nothing, and buying every chair and plate again made him wonder why we own what we own.

His own company called the idea a dollhouse game and didn't want it. It came out in 2000 and became the best-selling PC game of its time.

What was the first house you built?
